dedupe_keys.name: ruimtelijke belemmeringen en potentie voor windenergie op land

description: Ruimtelijke belemmeringen en potentie voor windenergie op land is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Nederland is opgedeeld in hexagonen. Ieder hexagon biedt ruimte aan één gemiddeld formaat windturbine (50 tot 90m diameter), 1,4 kleine windturbines (kleiner dan 50m diameter), of 0,7 grote windturbines (groter dan 90m diameter). Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are duurzaamheid, duurzame-energie, energie, energietransitie, landschap. It offers 3 resource(s) in PNG, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
